metadata.description: Claude Code skills from @0x45.dev for making YouTube videos for $0: make-video, snipshorts (free OpusClip alternative), cartoonsmith, edit-footage and podcast-summary.

plugins.name: make-video
plugins.description: Idea → script → voice → captions → music → Remotion render → QA, for $0. Free, local, no API keys.

plugins.name: snipshorts
plugins.description: Free, open-source OpusClip alternative, no watermark: a podcast, interview, Twitch/YouTube stream or GTA gameplay link → vertical Shorts with the speaker tracked, captions, SFX and posting copy. Add-on to make-video.

plugins.name: cartoonsmith
plugins.description: Voiced cartoon episodes with recurring characters: talking rigs from your character sheets, lip sync, captions, music, render and QA. Free and local. Add-on to make-video.

plugins.name: edit-footage
plugins.description: Your own raw talking-head recording → a finished vertical reel: best take of every line, false starts, fillers and pauses cut, captions, zooms, SFX. Free and local. Add-on to make-video and snipshorts.

plugins.name: podcast-summary
plugins.description: A podcast or interview link → an animated summary video (and/or a Short) in the speakers' real voices, with each speaker's real photo animated into a talking face by local AI, captions, topic titles, cards, a thumbnail and posting copy. Free and local. Add-on to make-video and snipshorts.
